_doc: One row per unlock on each calling's Act 1 ladder (docs/design/BUILD_UNLOCKS.md: a level that teaches a layer teaches nothing else; taught_builds.json holds which skill and level, this file what the card and the lesson say). level: where it opens. kind: key | stance | road. id: the skill's id, 'stance' or 'road'. lands: where it lands, in words ('key 4', 'swap', 'lamp-post'). title: the card header's words after 'LEVEL N · '. line: ONE line of what it does (72 characters at most, the game's plain voice); the card and LevelCards.Line read it first. icon: the glyph key the card draws ('' = the seat's own picture; the road takes 'roads', a forked path). start: true for the starting kit (key 1 at level 1, the ladder's own exception: no level-up card, no lesson of its own). teach: the lesson that follows the card (logic/Play/UnlockLessons.cs): when = next_fight (the next time a fight is near), first_fire (the thing itself: nothing said) or none; title and text for the hint (*asterisks* mark emphasis; {key} in the text is replaced by the label of the key named in key, the one the hint shows (UnlockLessons.TextFor); the text never says 'the key'); key = the Act name whose label the hint shows ('' none). Read by Content/UnlockCards.cs; UnlockCardTests holds the rule that every layer level has exactly one row.

warden.title: A NEW KEY
warden.line: Hold to cut. Every 6 s of cutting splits the ground in a line.

warden.title: A NEW KEY
warden.line: Leap where you aim, untouchable in the air, and knock them down.

teach.title: Heroic Leap
teach.text: *Aim* with the mouse and press *{key}*: you leap there, untouchable in the air, and knock down what you land on.

warden.title: A NEW KEY
warden.line: Hold to spin, cutting everything around you. Sunder's key breaks it.

teach.title: Bladestorm
teach.text: *Hold* {key} to spin, cutting all around you. Press Sunder's key to break the storm with one great blow.

warden.title: A ROAD TO WALK
warden.line: Walk one at a lamp-post: each changes how you fight.

warden.title: A SECOND WEAPON
warden.line: Swap to a second weapon: every swap lands a strike.

teach.title: Shieldwall
teach.text: Press *{key}* to swap to Shieldwall: every swap lands a strike.

warden.title: A NEW KEY
warden.line: Brace: for 2 s blows land at half, then burst back in a ring.

teach.title: Iron Vow
teach.text: Press *{key}* to brace: for 2 s every blow on you lands at half, then bursts back out in a ring.

warden.title: A NEW KEY
warden.line: Charge 8 m behind your shield; gain a barrier of 15% of your health.

teach.title: Shield Charge
teach.text: Press *{key}* to charge behind your shield: what stands in the way is struck and thrown aside.
